newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Dec qtr capital goods price index down 0.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: NZ Dec qtr capital goods price index down 0.1 pct.

text.p: The capital goods price index fell 0.1 percent in the December quarter, Statistics New Zealand said on Tuesday.
"This latest result continues falls of 0.2 percent in the September 1996 quarter and 0.1 percent in the June 1996 quarter," SNZ said.

It said the cost of construction of residential and non-residential buildings both rose 0.3 percent in the December quarter. The residential buildings index is now four percent higher than in the December 1995 quarter.
The cost of other construction fell 0.4 percent in the December quarter, following a 0.4 percent fall in the previous quarter.

The December quarter price movements for the six groups were: land improvements, up 0.7 percent; non-residential buildings, up 0.3 percent; residential buildings, up 0.3 percent; transport equipment, down 0.1 percent; plant machinery and equipment, down 0.1 percent; other construction, down 0.4 percent.
